about:
Eleven carpets laid directly on bare concrete, from Table 30.2 of the Spanish edition, each with its construction (woven or knotted), pile weight, pile height, pile surface (cut or loop), fibre and noise reduction coefficient. The pile weight and the pile height are printed twice, SI first and the US customary value in parentheses; the SI half is held. The noise reduction coefficient is the only acoustic quantity: the page prints no band, and the NRC is the arithmetic mean of the absorption coefficients at 250, 500, 1000 and 2000 Hz rounded to the nearest 0,05, so no band can be recovered from it. The construction, the pile surface and the fibre are printed as words and held as words; the surface and the fibre are the variant.

Four pile weights are pairs whose two halves are not each other, and they are registered in docs/ERRATA.md: three follow from the imperial half at 0,035 kg/m2 per oz/yd2 rather than the 0,0339 of the definition, and "1,3 (32)" follows at neither. Those four serve no pile weight. A fifth, "1,1 (3,2)", is a decimal comma in the imperial half, and its 1,1 kg/m2 is served.
